αἴαντας: Αἴας — Ajax, the name of two Greek heroes (the Telamonian and the Locrian); masc. acc. pl., the pair together: ’the Ajaxes’
αἴτιός: αἴτιος — to blame, responsible; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate (accent from the enclitic ἐστιν)
δαμῆναι: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — subdue, overpower; aor. pass. inf.: ’to be overcome’, ’to be subdued’ (+ ὑπό + dat. of the agent)
δερκομένοισι: δέρκομαι — look, see; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic δερκομένοις): ’to them as they look’
διελεύσεσθαι: διέρχομαι — go through, pass through; fut. inf. mid. (fut. stem ἐλευσ-), + acc.: ’to go through’
δοιοὺς: δοιοί — two (poetic alternative to δύο); numeral adj., masc. acc. pl.
δολιχὸν: δολιχός — long; adj., neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δόρυ: ’long’
θέει: θέω — run; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῖ)
θέσθε: τίθημι — put, place; aor. mid. imper. 2 pl.: ’put, lay (to heart)’
θόαντά: Θόας — Thoas, a Greek leader; masc. acc. sg. (accent from the enclitic τε)
καυλῷ: καυλός — stalk, stem; of a spear, the socket (or tang) of the head; masc. dat. sg.
κελευτιόων: κελευτιάω — keep urging, call on (from κελεύω); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κελευτιῶν)
κλισίηφι: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. dat. sg. in -φι (epic, = Attic κλισίᾳ): ’at the hut’
κοῦφα: κοῦφος — light, nimble; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’lightly’
κρινθέντες: κρίνω — separate, pick out, choose; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having been picked out’
κτείνονται: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. pass. 3 pl.: ’are being killed’
κτυπέει: κτυπέω — crash, resound; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted -έει (= Attic κτυπεῖ)
λέλυντο: λύω — loose, undo; plpf. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐλέλυντο): ’had been loosed’; of limbs, ’had given way’
λήϊτον: Λήϊτος — Leitus, a Greek leader; masc. acc. sg.
λαμπροῖσι: λαμπρός — bright, shining; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic λαμπροῖς)
λαοσσόος: λαοσσόος — rousing the host (λαός + σεύω; derivation disputed), epithet of Athena; fem. nom. sg. of a two-ending adjective
λευγαλέοιο: λευγαλέος — wretched, grievous, baneful; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μέχρι: μέχρι — as far as, until; prep. + gen.: ’as far as’
μήστωρας: μήστωρ — adviser, deviser; in μήστωρ ἀϋτῆς ’masters of the war-cry’; masc. acc. pl.
μαρναμένοισι: μάρναμαι — fight; pres. part. mid., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic μαρναμένοις)
μαχεσσαίμην: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic μαχεσαίμην), + dat., potential with ἄν: ’I would fight’
μεθήσετε: μεθίημι — let go, give up, slacken from (+ gen.); fut. 2 pl.: ’you will give up’
μεθείη: μεθίημι — let go, give up (+ gen.); aor. opt. 3 sg., in a relative clause of indefinite sense: ’whoever should hold back from’
μεθημοσύνῃ: μεθημοσύνη — slackness, remissness (from μεθίημι); fem. dat. sg.: ’through slackness’
μεθημοσύνῃσί: μεθημοσύνη — slackness, remissness; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις); accent from the enclitic τε
μεθιέμεναι: μεθίημι — let go, give up, hold back from (+ gen.); pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic μεθιέναι)
μετεισάμενος: μέτειμι — go among, go after (epic aor. mid. μετεισάμην); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’going among’
μηριόναο: Μηριόνης — Meriones, a Cretan warrior, Idomeneus’ comrade; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
νέμεσιν: νέμεσις — righteous indignation, the censure of one’s fellows; fem. acc. sg.: ’indignation’
νεμεσσῶμαι: νεμεσσάομαι — be indignant with, resent; pres. 1 sg. mid., contracted, epic doubled σ (= Attic νεμεσῶμαι), + dat. of the person
νευόντων: νεύω — nod, bend forward; pres. part. act. masc. gen. pl.: ’as they nod’
ξίφεσίν: ξίφος — sword; neut. dat. pl., accented before enclitic τε
ξυνέαξε: συνάγνυμι (ξυνάγνυμι) — break together, shatter; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with ξυν- for συν-: ’shattered’
οἰσόμενος: φέρω — carry, bring; fut. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., of purpose with active sense (fut. οἴσομαι): ’to fetch’
πέποιθα: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα, with present sense: trust, rely on (+ dat.); 1 sg.
πέτεται: πέτομαι — fly, leap; pres. 3 sg.: ’flies, bounds’
παρδαλίων: πάρδαλις — leopard, panther; fem. gen. pl.
παρμένετ: παραμένω — stand fast, hold out; pres. imper. 2 pl., with apocope and elision (παρμένετ’ = παραμένετε)
πηνέλεών: Πηνέλεως — Peneleos, a Greek leader; masc. acc. sg., Πηνέλεων with accent from the enclitic θ’
ποιήσετε: ποιέω — make, do; fut. 2 pl.: ’you will do’
πολεμίζει: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. 3 sg.
προβιβὰς: προβιβάω — stride forward, advance (epic βιβάω ’stride’); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’striding forward’
προθελύμνῳ: προθέλυμνος — of a shield: perhaps ’in many layers’ (cf. θέλυμνα ’foundations’); sense uncertain; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic
προποδίζων: προποδίζω — step forward (πρό + πούς); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’stepping forward’
προὔτυψαν: προτύπτω — strike forward, press on; aor. 3 pl. act., with crasis and augment (προὔτυψαν = προέτυψαν): ’pressed forward’
πυκινῇς: πυκινός — close-packed, dense; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= -ῃσι, Attic -αῖς)
πυκνοὶ: πυκνός — thick, close-set; adj., masc. nom. pl.
σαωσέμεναι: σαόω (= σώζω) — save, keep safe; fut. inf. act., epic -σέμεναι (= Attic σώσειν): ’to save’
σειόμεν: σείω — shake, brandish; pres. part. mid.-pass. neut. nom. pl., elided (σειόμεν’ = σειόμενα): ’shaking’
σχέθ: ἔχω — have, hold; 2 aor. 3 sg. σχέθε, epic, unaugmented (= ἔσχε), elided: ’held (away)’
σχήσουσιν: ἔχω — have, hold, hold back; fut. 3 pl. σχήσω (= Attic ἕξω): ’they will check’
τελευτήσεσθαι: τελευτάω — accomplish, bring to an end; fut. mid. inf. with passive sense: ’to be fulfilled, to come to pass’
τεῦκρον: Τεῦκρος — Teucer, a Greek warrior; masc. acc. sg.
φάλαγξι: φάλαγξ — line of battle, phalanx; fem. dat. pl.
φάλοισι: φάλος — a part of the helmet, probably the ridge that holds the crest; exact sense uncertain; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
φεύξεσθαι: φεύγω — flee, escape; fut. inf. mid., in indirect statement after ἔφαν: ’that they would flee’
φρόνεον: φρονέω — think, be minded; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἐφρόνουν): ’were minded’
φυζακινῇς: φυζακινός — timid, ready to flee (φύζα ’flight’); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= -ῃσι, Attic -αῖς)
χάρμη: χάρμη — joy of battle, eagerness to fight; fem. nom. sg.: ’fighting spirit’
χάσσονται: χάζομαι — draw back, give ground; fut. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic χάσονται): ’will give way’
χειμάρροος: χείμαρρος — winter-flowing, swollen with rain (χεῖμα + ῥέω); masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χείμαρρους)
χώσατο: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐχώσατο): ’was enraged’
ψαῦον: ψαύω — touch, brush against; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔψαυον)
ἀκεσταί: ἀκεστός — curable, that can be mended (ἀκέομαι); adj., fem. nom. pl.
ἀκεώμεθα: ἀκέομαι — heal, mend, put right; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortatory, epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀκώμεθα): ’let us mend’
ἀμφιγύοισιν: ἀμφίγυος — epithet of spears, perhaps ’double-ended’ or ’strong on both sides’; sense uncertain; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀνάλκιδες: ἄναλκις — without might, strengthless, feeble (ἀ- + ἀλκή); adj. of two endings, masc./fem. nom. pl.
ἀνέρα: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., epic ἀνέρα (= Attic ἄνδρα)
ἀνέψυχον: ἀναψύχω — cool again, refresh, revive; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented after the preverb: ’were reviving’
ἀναθρῴσκων: ἀναθρῴσκω — leap up, bound up; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’leaping up’
ἀναιδέος: ἀναιδής — shameless, ruthless (ἀ- + αἰδώς); adj. of two endings, fem. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
ἀντίλοχον: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. acc. sg.
ἀπείλει: ἀπειλέω — threaten, vaunt; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἠπείλει): ’was vaunting’
ἀπητίμησε: ἀπατιμάω — dishonour, slight; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’slighted’
ἀργαλέῳ: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; masc. dat. sg.
ἀσπέτῳ: ἄσπετος — immense, unspeakable, vast; masc. dat. sg.
ἀσφαλέως: ἀσφαλής — safe, sure, steady; adv. ἀσφαλέως: ’steadily, unfalteringly’
ἐάγη: ἄγνυμι — break; aor. 3 sg. pass., augmented with lengthened vowel: ’was broken’
ἐγίγνετο: γίγνομαι — become, come about, come to be; impf. 3 sg.
ἐθέλεσκον: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 pl., iterative in -εσκ- (epic): ’were wont to consent’
ἐλάφοισιν: ἔλαφος — deer, hind; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἐνέκυρσε: ἐγκύρω — meet, light upon (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. act. ἐνέκυρσε (from κύρω): ’ran upon’
ἐοίκεσαν: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; plpf. 3 pl., epic ἐοίκεσαν (= Attic ἐῴκεσαν), + dat., with force of an imperfect: ’were like’
ἐπτύσσοντο: πτύσσω — fold, bend; impf. 3 pl. mid.-pass., said of spears; exact sense (’bent, quivered’) uncertain
ἐρίσαντες: ἐρίζω — contend, quarrel with (+ dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having quarrelled with’
ἔγχεσιν: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. pl.: ’with spears’ (instrumental)
ἔμιμνον: μίμνω — stay, wait, remain; impf. 3 pl., epic reduplicated present of μένω (= Attic ἔμενον)
ἔρειδε: ἐρείδω — press, push, prop; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’pressed against’
ἔφασκον: φημί — say, assert; impf. 1 sg., iterative in -σκ- (epic): ’I kept saying’
ἠλάσκουσαι: ἠλάσκω — wander, roam, stray; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.
ἤϊα: ἤϊα (ἠΐα) — provisions, food; of wild beasts, their prey; neut. nom. pl., predicate
ἰσόπεδον: ἰσόπεδος — level, even; neut. acc. sg. used as a noun: ’level ground’
ἱππόκομοι: ἱππόκομος — with a horsehair crest (ἵππος + κόμη); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl.
ὀλοοίτροχος: ὀλοοίτροχος — rolling stone, boulder (perhaps ’destructive wheel’); masc. nom. sg.
ὁρῶμαι: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg. mid. with active sense (epic): ’I behold’
ὑπασπίδια: ὑπασπίδιος — under the shield; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’under cover of the shield’
ὤσῃ: ὠθέω — push, thrust, dislodge; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative clause without ἄν (epic)

__broaden__.αὐτοῖο: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic αὐτοῦ): ’him’, after πάροιθε ’before him’ · also masc. gen. sg., object of τιτύσκετο: ’at him’
__broaden__.δεινόν: δεινός — terrible, dread, awesome; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’dreadfully’ · also masc. acc. sg., adj. agreeing with an understood ’him’ (the boar), with περ ἐόντα: ’though he is dreadful’ · also neut. acc. sg., adj. agreeing with θαῦμα: ’a dreadful (wonder)’
__broaden__.μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’) · also pres. inf. as an imperative: ’fight!’ (μάχεσθαι ἐνὶ πρώτοισι) · also pres. inf. in an indirect alternative question: ’whether to fight’ (ἢ φευγέμεν ἠὲ μάχεσθαι ’whether to flee or to fight’) · also pres. inf., complementary after ἀριστεύεσκε: ’(be best) at fighting’ (ὃς ἀριστεύεσκε μάχεσθαι ’who used to excel in fighting’) · also pres. inf. after a verb of urging or joining: ’to fight’ (Δαναοὺς ὀτρύνετον … μάχεσθαι ’urge the Danaans to fight’) · also pres. inf., complementary after μέμασαν: ’(were eager) to fight’
__broaden__.μεθίετε: μεθίημι — let go, slacken, give up (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 pl. · also pres. indic. 2 pl., in a question: ’you slacken’ · also pres. indic. 2 pl. in a reproach, + gen.: ’you give up (impetuous might)’
__broaden__.πριαμίδης: Πριαμίδης — son of Priam; masc. nom. sg., patronymic, of Hector · also of another son of Priam (Antiphus) · also of Helenus · also of Deiphobus
__broaden__.στεφάνης: στεφάνη — rim, ring; of a helmet, its rim (exact part uncertain); fem. gen. sg. · also of a hill or cliff, its brow or ridge: ’down from the brow’
__broaden__.τιτύσκετο: τιτύσκομαι — make ready, prepare, fit out; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic (poetic verb, no Attic present): ’was making ready’ · also + gen., of aiming a weapon: ’aimed at’
__broaden__.τῇδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’in this place, at this spot’ · also fem. dat. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τῇδε μεθημοσύνῃ ’by this slackness’)
__broaden__.χάρμῃ: χάρμη — joy of battle, battle; fem. dat. sg., with προκαλέσσατο: ’in the joy of battle’ · also dat. of cause with γηθόσυνοι: ’glad with the joy of battle’
__broaden__.ἁμάς: ἁμός — our (Aeolic form of ἡμέτερος, found in epic); fem. acc. pl., agreeing with χεῖρας: ’our (hands)’ · also agreeing with νέας: ’our (ships)’
__broaden__.ἡγεμόνος: ἡγεμών — guide, leader; masc. gen. sg., after a verb of lacking (+ gen.) · also masc. gen. sg., possessive with a noun: ’of the leader’ (ἡγεμόνος κακότητι ’through the leader’s baseness’)
__broaden__.ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
__broaden__.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’)
__broaden__.θαῦμα: θαῦμα — wonder, marvel; neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’a wonder to see’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ὁρῶμαι: ’a wonder’
__broaden__.πέλονται: πέλομαι — be, become; of distances, extend, run; pres. 3 pl.: ’they go, extend’ · also pres. 3 pl., copulative with a predicate noun: ’are, become’ (ἤϊα πέλονται ’become food’)
__broaden__.εἷος: εἷος — while, until (epic, = Attic ἕως); conj., correlative with τόφρα: ’while’ · also εἷος + aor. subj., ’until’ (εἷος ἵκηται ’until it reaches’)
